title: membrane_evo needs its death disks: on seed 24, p_death=0 gives 1 persistent split and a frozen lattice vs 11 splits with disks
summary: Fresh seed 24, t=40000. membrane_evo_up with p_death=0 (world_up_nodisk.py): walled cells form from noise, fill the box and freeze into a square lattice by t~10000 (up_nodisk/sheet.png); labkit 1 split, 1 persistent split, generation 1; later kind changes are whole-cell flips of frozen cells. Same seed with the disks (membrane_evo_up as published): 54 splits, 11 persistent, generation 4. evotrack with p_death=0: up K2 share 0.22 with 1 birth and 0 deaths; twin 0.50 with 0 births and 0 deaths, so up and twin no longer separate (and the up arm is even lower).

observations.F: up_nodisk/sheet.png frozen lattice from t~10000; up_nodisk/FACTS.md 1 persistent split vs up_disk/FACTS.md 11; evo/*.json births 0-1, deaths 0

verdicts.limitation: One new seed. The finding's necessary=true is for this parameter point; a different feed or a maintenance cost might restore turnover without disks, which is the open question for C:autonomous-heredity.
